title: Reality unfolds along a preferred sequence of nows

statements.text: The objective reading of von Neumann theory assumes a preferred sequence of instants now along which reductions act instantly. It agrees with relativity on every empirical relation but rejects the idea that there is no preferred sequence of nows, and the cosmic rest frame of the early universe may be that sequence.

sources.quote: the theory does conflict with a metaphysical idea spawned by the theory of relativity, namely the idea that there is no dynamically preferred sequence of instantaneous “nows”
It is natural to assume that these empirically specified surfaces are the same as the objective preferred surfaces “now” of von Neumann quantum theory.
